acceptanceAssertions.title: authenticates the full consent envelope with independent purpose and bounded lifetime
supports previous keys for remaining lifetime and rejects retired keys
rejects exactly at expiry and never issues evidence longer than thirty days
cannot substitute functional or Measurement identity envelopes for consent, or consent for identity
rejects shared key material including previous-key reuse and malformed evidence
persists explicit grants across fresh service/pool instances and withdrawal revokes unexpired evidence
denied/unknown/unsupported notices issue no identity; missing and forged evidence have no writes
foreign Portfolio, unsupported notice and removed consent never authorize evidence
crypto failure rolls back consent and minimal history atomically
concurrent grant and withdrawal serialize one revision and reject the stale writer
transaction-participating verification holds withdrawal until intake commits
restricted roles enforce scope, append-only history and expiry-only worker deletion
the real HTTP boundary requires current signed evidence and emits safe commands/receipts/logs
standard runtime assembly exposes the consent boundary and optional absence leaves core readiness available
renewal preserves unexpired subjects but rotates them exactly at or after expiry
persisted current consent accepts supported previous-key evidence without changing subject
